book.name: Lum
book.title: Ŋwa' wvù Baul to saŋɛɛ ɛ̂ kentaashɛ ke Lum

content: Abla'am nu kenfewsɛn ke wee wvù Nyo' joo lɛ wvú nu sɛ jay e
Ɛ̀ nulo ɛ́ beene egay lɛ Abla'am wvù icee kfuu disɛɛbeene to yɛn lɛ la ɛkumɛ saaka wvun?
Ɛ́ Nyo' fɛn to jo Abla'am lɛ wvú nu sɛ jay ɛ ɛ̀ nu nje lemme dì jee dì wvú to geɛ, kɛ tu wvú nulo ekfune gvuw ɛkumɛ fí. Geenɛn, kɛ wvú kɛŋke naa lo fiɛɛ fì wvú nulo ekfune gvuw dvú ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛjise kɛ,
njefo Ŋwa' Nyo' gayte lɛ,

content.text: “Abla'am to nu ɛ lese fitele yî Nyo' le,
ɛ Nyo' mum jo wvú lɛ wvú nu wee wvu teytey.”

content: Wee wvù lemte ɛ bó laake wvú, ké lemte ɛ́ bó elaw wvú, bó saa ejo lɛ nlawma we nu kɛ lo nnya ɛ bó ɛ nya ɛ̂ wvú kɛ. Ɛ bó jo lɛ ɛ̀ nu nlawma wvù wvú kɛŋke keekɛŋkɛ.

Geenɛn, ɛ́ wee nu sɛ wvú ɛ lem fiɛɛ, ɛ lese ɛ ɛ̀ nu fitele yî Nyo' wvù joo bonyii bò befe lɛ bó nu sɛ jay ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise, tu Nyo' nu ejo mwɛtɛn lɛ wvú nu teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise nje fitele fì wvú lese yî ye le.
Dawe tɛn to nu ɛ jeme lɛ njoŋ wvu baay nu wvu bonyii bò Nyo' joo lɛ bó nu teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu nje lemme dì bó nu ɛ lem kɛ.
Wvú to nu ɛ jeme lɛ,

content.text: “Njoŋ wvu baay nu fô bonyii bò Nyo' nu ɛ lɛɛshɛ wase bojay bobole,
Ɛ njoŋ wvu baay nu fô wee wvù Nyo' yaa bɛɛ ŋgoyte fite

content: No fí nu nonɛn, tu njoŋ wvu baay wvun nu kɛ fô bonyii bò bó nu ɛ tfuse bó yew maaŋ e? Nuu lɛ wvú nu tɛn fô bò bɛɛ ntffuse le lɛ? Beene be ɛ gay wase lɛ, “Fitele fì Abla'am to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le to nu ɛ ge ɛ Nyo' jo wvú lɛ wvú nu wee wvu teytey.”
Nyo' to jo Abla'am lɛ wvú nu wee wvu teytey ɛ ɛ̀ nu seke la? Ɛ̀ to nu ɛ bó ɛ tfuse wase wvú yew, nuu ɛ wvú bɛɛ ntffuse lɛ? Ɛ̀ to nu ɛ wvú bɛɛ ntffuse. Kɛ bó to baa tfuse wase wvú yew kɛ.

Bó to tfuse wvú yew diɛwɛ nciise le keeduŋcɛ lɛ wvú nu wase wee wvu teytey nje fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le seke wvú to bɛɛ ntffuse. Nonɛn Abla'am ɛ mum ɛ no nu icee bonyii bocii bò nu ɛ lese fitele yî Nyo' le ɛ bó baa tfuse bó yew kɛ, wvu lɛ Nyo' ejo tɛn bó lɛ bó nu bonyii bo teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise.
Ɛ wvú nu tɛn icee bonyii bò bó nu ɛ tfuse wase bó yew, ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu kɛ nje bó nu ɛ tfuse bó yew kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu nje bó nu ɛ jo ɛkalɛ kew yî fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le ɛ bó sɛ ke tfuse wvú yew.
Abla'am to kɛŋke fiɛɛ fì Nyo' kawɛɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu nje fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le

Ŋkawma wvù Nyo' to kawɛɛ Abla'am lɛ wvú bô boom bew nu ke eyow ɛkolɛ ke nshɛ le to baa nu nje Abla'am to gɛɛle bonci kɛ. Ɛ̀ to nu nje fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le, ɛ Nyo' jo wvú lɛ wvú nu teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise.
Ɛ́ ɛ̀ to nu lɛ bonyii bò nu ke ekɛŋkɛ fiɛɛ fì Nyo' to kawɛɛ nu kɛ bonyii bò gee no bonci gomte, kɛ tu fitele fì bó leese yî Nyo' le yaa kɛŋke sɛw kɛ, ɛ ŋkawma wvù Nyo' kawɛɛ wvudvu nu tɛn ɛcici.
Fiɛɛ fì nu, nu lɛ bonci ké no gee kɛ ɛ shém ffuuke lo Nyo', njefo ɛ́ nci baa enu, fiɛɛ fimew saa enu lɛ wee nu ɛ ŋgoy nci kɛ.

Fí ɛ mum ɛ no nu lɛ, ŋkawma wvudvu bii ɛ ɛ̀ nu fitele fì wvú lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le wvu lɛ ɛ́ enu mbuwma ɛ wvú ɛ to fô wvú le, ɛ fiɛɛ fì wvú kawɛɛ fidvu kɛŋke keekooy fô kfuu diew e dicii, ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nu kɛ fô bonyii bò leeme yî bonci le maaŋ kɛ. Ɛ̀ nu tɛn fô bonyii bò nu ɛ lese fitele yî Nyo' le lɛŋlɛŋ no Abla'am to lesɛɛ, njefo Abla'am nu icee wesebeene bocii bò nu bonyii bo Nyo' le.
Fifin nu no bó nu ɛ saŋ ɛ Nyo' gayte ɛ̂ Abla'am lɛ,

content.text: “Me nu ɛ ŋge lɛ wo enù icee bitum nteen.”

content: Wvú nu icee wesebeene ɛ̂ Nyo' ɛjise. Ɛ̀ nu Nyo' wvù Abla'am to lesɛɛ fitele yî ye le. Ɛ ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù gee ɛ bonyii bò nu ɛ kpwekɛn wase kaase tuu dvú. Ɛ ɛ̀ bvuu nu wvú wvù gee ɛ mwɛɛm mvù ke baa nu wase dvú sɛ nu dvú.

Abla'am to nu ɛ no taale kɛ fwe kee lɛ wen nu ke ekɛŋkɛ fiɛɛ fì Nyo' kawɛɛ naa no wvú to nu wase ɛ ɛ̀ yaa nulo ɛ́ wvú ebvuu etaale fwe yî fiɛɛ le kɛ. Geenɛn, ɛ wvú lese kɛ fitele yî Nyo' le ke ghan no nu, “Icee bitum nteen”, kɛ no Nyo' to kawɛɛ ɛ̂ wvú lɛ,

Ɛ̀ to nu ɛ Abla'am gɛne wase bilum gbwee, geenɛn ɛ wvú faŋɛ yaa ewɛɛ yî fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le kɛ, naa no wvú to yɛne ɛkolɛ kew e lɛ wen nu wase diɛwɛ wee wvù nu ɛ kpwe wase le, yɛne tɛn lɛ kpwɛse wvù Sɛla nu kase ɛ tee diew ɛ lɛ wase.

Wvú to baa ekɛw ekɛŋke kemaŋɛn wvu lɛ wvú enɛ ekɛŋke mvuntelem mvunfɛɛm ɛkumɛ ŋkawma wvù Nyo' kawɛɛ wvú dvú kɛ. Fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le to nu ɛ tɛme gɛn lo fwe, ɛ wvú no tumte kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu moŋkum mo Nyo' le.
Wvú to nu ɛ mum bee naa bô fitele fiew ficii lɛ Nyo' kɛŋke mvuŋgay keege fiɛɛ fì wvú to kawɛɛ.
Ɛ̀ nɛɛ fiɛɛ fì fitele fì wvú to lesɛɛ yî Nyo' le to nu ɛ ge ɛ Nyo' jo lɛ wvú nu wee wvu teytey ɛ̂ wvú ɛjise.
Geenɛn, njeme wvu lɛ, “Nyo' to nu ɛ jo wvú nonɛn,” nu ɛ bó yaa saŋ kɛ ɛ ɛ̀ nu fô Abla'am e maaŋ kɛ.
Wvú nu tɛn fô beene le. Nyo' wvù beene lese fitele yî ye le nu ke ejo tɛn beene nonɛn. Ɛ̀ nu wvú wvù to bvusɛɛ Jisos wvù Tata wesebeene yî kpwe le.
Jisos nu wvù bó to nyaɛ ɛ wvú kpwe nje bibefɛ bisɛɛbeene. Ɛ Nyo' kase bvuse wvú yî kpwe le wvu lɛ wen ejo lɛ beene nu sɛ jay.
